packageRules.description: Claude Code hook runtime contract. cc-hooks-ts mirrors Claude Code's hook input schema version-for-version (closed valibot enums), so a stale pin makes hooks fail to parse and die before their body runs — SessionStart source=fork did exactly that in 2026-07. Keep these out of the weekly all-non-major group so they land as soon as minimumReleaseAge clears instead of waiting on the slowest package in a 24-dep group. The split relies on packageRules order: repo rules are appended after preset rules, so this groupName overrides the one group:allNonMajor assigns
Auto-merge non-major hook runtime updates. Majors stay manual: cc-hooks-ts v2 required call-site changes, and the agent SDK is consumed directly by hook code

Keep mise cargo: backend versions bare. The preset's rangeStrategy=pin writes cargo range syntax (=1.2.3), which mise rejects as an unsupported semver range; bump updates the bare version in place instead
